resale_co.how_to_apply: The Borough does not require a Certificate of Occupancy for a resale. The seller only needs the state smoke alarm / carbon monoxide alarm certificate from the Ocean County Fire Marshal (see the fire certificate section).

evidence.quote: Our Borough does not require a Certificate of Occupancy (CO) for a resale or rental of a home.
Our Borough does not require a Certificate of Occupancy (CO) for a resale or rental of a home. No dwelling shall be rented or leased for a term less than 30 days in the Borough of Point Pleasant.
Zoning & Code Enforcement Officer Colleen Malvasio zoningcode@ptboro.com 732-892-3434 ext. 120

resale_co.notes: Rentals of less than 30 days are not allowed. Pre-1978 rentals need a lead-based paint inspection and a $20 per unit lead-safe or lead-free certification filing; that is rental-only. The Zoning & Code Enforcement Dept. office line is 732-892-3205 (zoningcode@ptboro.com); the Building Dept. is 732-892-7129 (construction@ptboro.com; Construction Official Andrew Rempfer). The Borough website ptboro.com carries many injected casino spam links on its pages (the site looks compromised), but the Borough content itself reads normally. The Borough code (ecode360 PO0252) could not be opened.

requirements: Smoke alarms on every level including the basement; on levels with bedrooms, within 10 feet of the bedrooms
All smoke alarms, including hardwired ones, must be under 10 years old
Homes built before 1978: at least one 10-year sealed battery smoke alarm on each level

Homes built 1978 to 1983: hardwired alarms on each level; 1984 to 1990: interconnected hardwired alarms with battery backup on each level; 1991 and later: interconnected hardwired alarms with battery backup in bedrooms and on each level
Hardwired alarms that must be replaced because of age must be replaced with hardwired alarms, not battery alarms

Carbon monoxide alarm near the sleeping areas (not needed if no fuel-burning device and no attached garage); battery-only and plug-in CO alarms should be under 5 years old, combination smoke/CO alarms under 10 years
Homes with a generator, solar panels or battery storage need a printed 'CAUTION: MULTIPLE SOURCES OF POWER' label within 18 inches of the main electrical panel and the electric meter
Homes with a monitored low-voltage fire alarm system need an NFPA 72 test report from the alarm company before closing
No fire extinguisher is required since February 3, 2025
Certificate is valid for 12 months from the inspection date

authorities.how_to_apply: Fill out the Ocean County Fire Marshal's online application (Fill Out Application link on the Resale & Rental Home Inspections page). The office then contacts you to schedule the inspection. Do not mail payment: pay at the inspection by paper check payable to Ocean County Fire Marshal (OCFM), credit card or e-check. Cash is not accepted. Office: 179 South Main St., Manahawkin, NJ 08050.
